boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Jefferson rituals spanning arrival, professional milestones, design, music, and medical-school celebration.

cards.title: Enter Convocation Through a Faculty Welcome Line
cards.subtitle: Incoming-class Convocation, East Falls
cards.notes: At Convocation, follow the incoming class along the walkway into the Gallagher Center while university leaders, faculty, and staff cheer.
cards.short_summary: A public, cheering welcome marks the start of the undergraduate journey.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson describes leaders, faculty, and staff cheering as incoming students and families stream down the walkway into Gallagher Center as an annual Convocation tradition.
cards.access_notes: Part of incoming-student Convocation programming; attendance and guest details vary by year.

cards.title: Nominate a Teacher Who Got You Here
cards.subtitle: Incoming-class Convocation, East Falls
cards.notes: Before Convocation, think of an educator who shaped your path and submit a nomination when the incoming-class process opens.
cards.short_summary: New Jefferson students formally recognize a pre-college educator.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson identifies incoming students nominating a remarkable educator who influenced their academic lives as a special Convocation tradition.
cards.access_notes: Participation is tied to Convocation and may be limited to the incoming class.

cards.entity_name: Sidney Kimmel Medical College White Coat Ceremony
cards.title: Receive the First White Coat
cards.subtitle: Sidney Kimmel Medical College
cards.notes: Join the entering medical class and invited supporters for the white-coat presentation that formally begins the Jefferson medical-school journey.
cards.short_summary: A white-coat presentation welcomes each new SKMC class to medicine.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson says the White Coat Ceremony marks the official start of the Sidney Kimmel Medical College Class of 2027's medical-school journey.
cards.source_title: On a Path With Purpose, Med Students Receive Their White Coats
cards.access_notes: For SKMC entering students; ceremony timing, venue, and guest arrangements are announced by the college.

cards.title: Recite the Hippocratic Oath in the New Coat
cards.subtitle: Sidney Kimmel Medical College White Coat Ceremony
cards.notes: During the White Coat Ceremony, take part in the class oath recital that connects the first coat with patient-focused professional commitments.
cards.short_summary: Jefferson's new medical students pair the first coat with an oath recital.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson reports that SKMC students recited the Maimonides Prayer for the Physician and the Hippocratic Oath as part of the White Coat Ceremony.
cards.source_title: On a Path With Purpose, Med Students Receive Their White Coats
cards.access_notes: For White Coat Ceremony participants; the exact program may change by class year.

cards.entity_name: Jefferson College of Pharmacy White Coat Ceremony
cards.title: Be Coated by a Pharmacy Faculty Advisor
cards.subtitle: Jefferson College of Pharmacy
cards.notes: Attend the pharmacy class ceremony, where each student receives a white coat from a faculty advisor to begin the professional journey.
cards.short_summary: Student pharmacists receive their first professional coat from faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson says each Jefferson College of Pharmacy student received a white coat from a faculty advisor during the 2023 ceremony.
cards.access_notes: For entering Jefferson College of Pharmacy students; check college communications for current details.

cards.title: Close the Pharmacy Coat Ceremony With the Oath
cards.subtitle: Jefferson College of Pharmacy
cards.notes: At the pharmacy white-coat ceremony, join the class in reciting the Oath of a Pharmacist after the individual coat presentations.
cards.short_summary: The incoming pharmacy class voices its professional oath together.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson states that its 2023 Jefferson College of Pharmacy White Coat Ceremony concluded with students reciting the Oath of the Pharmacist.
cards.access_notes: For participants in the pharmacy White Coat Ceremony; confirm the current ceremony program with the college.

cards.title: Return Each Spring for the Student Fashion Show
cards.subtitle: College of Fashion & Textiles
cards.notes: Follow the annual spring show to see Jefferson fashion-design work presented as a celebration of students’ four-year creative development.
cards.short_summary: Each spring, Jefferson stages a student fashion-design celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson says each spring brings its Annual Student Fashion Design Show, celebrating Fashion Design students' work.
cards.source_title: Fashion & Textile Design Courses & Degree Programs
cards.access_notes: Scheduled in spring; public access, tickets, and venue details vary by edition.

cards.title: Send Senior Collections Down Jefferson’s Runway
cards.subtitle: Annual Fashion Show, College of Fashion & Textiles
cards.notes: For a senior capstone milestone, prepare a collection for the annual show’s runway presentation and its audience of peers and industry guests.
cards.short_summary: Fashion Design seniors are invited to present capstone collections on the runway.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson says every Fashion Design senior is invited to showcase a capstone collection on the runway at the Annual Fashion Show.
cards.access_notes: For Fashion Design seniors; show production and audience details are set for each annual event.

cards.title: Keep a Piece of Handel’s Messiah in the Concert
cards.subtitle: Thomas Jefferson University Choir
cards.notes: Listen for the Jefferson University Choir’s recurring Handel selection in its concert repertoire, alongside classical, rock, jazz, and newer works.
cards.short_summary: A portion of Handel’s Messiah is a recurring University Choir tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson Magazine identifies part of Handel's Messiah as an annual tradition for the Thomas Jefferson University Choir.
cards.access_notes: Concert dates and repertoire are announced by the choir; performance access varies by event.

cards.title: Open the Residency Envelope Together at Noon
cards.subtitle: Sidney Kimmel Medical College Match Day
cards.notes: At Match Day, gather with the graduating medical class and loved ones for the coordinated envelope opening that reveals residency placements.
cards.short_summary: Jefferson medical students share the residency reveal with classmates and supporters.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson reports that the SKMC Class of 2026 tore open envelopes at Match Day to learn where they would complete residencies.
cards.source_title: Match Day Marks Defining Moment for Jefferson Medical Students
cards.access_notes: For eligible fourth-year SKMC students; event attendance and supporter arrangements are set by the college.
